author: August Schwerdfeger
name: LabelsToTags
description: Applies tags in bulk to selected images based on their color labels and star ratings using configurable pattern mappings.
description-extensive: This tool lets you automatically add keyword tags to lots of photos at once, using the color labels and star ratings you have already given them as a guide. You set up rules that say things like 'any photo with a red label and 5 stars gets these tags', then run it across your selected images. It is a fast way to organize large batches without tagging each photo by hand. No extra software is required.
